instructions.question: Does this Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express warm approval or hope, an explicit hostile or distressed feeling, or neither (information, requests, suggestions, banter)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default. Data requests, 'why' questions, demands for measures, comparisons, serious scolding of careless citizens, sarcasm about testing and city 'league' banter stay neutral, even when critical or accusatory. Choose negative only for an explicit marker: blame, a claim the numbers are fake, an insult or curse, a fed-up statement, or the commenter's own fear or despair. Positive needs praise, thanks, relief at good numbers or hope for zero cases; praise mixed with criticism stays positive.

neutral.what: Tags, statistics, observations, requests for details, questions, proposals, scolding without insults, comparisons, jokes and banter, including critical or sarcastic ones.
examples: Mbyllni kufinjt mos luani me jetet e njerzve (Close the borders, don't play with people's lives)
Nëse nuk bëjmë asnjë test, s'do të kemi asnjë rast. U zgjidh problemi. (If we do no tests, we'll have no cases. Problem solved.)
Po shihet qe njerezit nuk jane te diciplinuar (It's clear people aren't disciplined)
Jeckpoot...vushtri e dhezi..apet (Jackpot... Vushtrri lit up again)
neutral.cues: personal names, publikoni (publish), testoni (test), mbyllni (close), pse (why), rrini n'shpi (stay home), ma gjall (livelier), on top, hahaha
neutral.not_for: Explicit blame, fake-number claims, insults or curses, being fed up, or own fear are negative.

positive.what: Praise or thanks to doctors or the institute, congratulations, hope or prayers for no cases, cheering at recoveries.
examples: Respekt per punen tuaj (Respect for your work)
shpresoj qe ta kalojmë këtë gjendje me sa më pak pasoja. (I hope we get through this with as few consequences as possible.)
Ajde ma gjall ma gjall t sherum (Come on, more and more recovered)
positive.cues: bravo (well done), respekt (respect), faleminderit (thanks), urime (congratulations), shpresoj (I hope), inshallah (God willing), asnje rast (no cases), mir (good)
positive.not_for: City-ranking banter ('n Top form', 'kryesorja') and 'ma gjall' cheering of infections are neutral.

negative.what: Blame, claims the numbers are invented, insults or curses, fed-up frustration, fear or despair.
examples: Qeveria koti ika fajet (The Kurti government is to blame)
Veq shifren e par pja ndrroni se tekstin tjeter veq copy paste po get (You only change the first number, the rest is copy paste)
U ba bajat me ka 200 mo  ndrrone pak (It's stale with 200 a day, change it a bit)
Krejt Rrena (All lies)
negative.cues: faj (blame), rrena/prralla (lies/fairy tales), aparati (the machine), bajat (stale), lodhet (tired), magari (donkey), pisa (dirty one), injorantat (the ignorant), ju raft (may it strike you), qeveria Koti (Kurti's government, mocking), tmerr (horror), deshtim (failure)
negative.not_for: Requests, proposals, serious scolding, questions or banter without such a marker are neutral.
